youtube.title: From the original emblem to a vector trace with new, live Hebrew and English text
youtube.description:
From the original emblem to a redraw traced into vectors with funkbox's image_trace: the lettering is lifted out of the artwork and the words are set back on top as live text layers, which the text audit checks exactly. Then before/after, and two mashups.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
